issue_request: FHIR-11392 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 Financial Management change request asking to rename the ExplanationOfBenefit Diagnosis drg attribute to packageCode.
initial_application: Historical commit d06f8787e6, titled "Tracker #11375, 11376, 11391, 11392", applied the requested rename in the then-authoritative EOB spreadsheet source by changing ExplanationOfBenefit.diagnosis.drg to ExplanationOfBenefit.diagnosis.packageCode and updating the short, definition, and requirements.
additional_context: ExplanationOfBenefit is an active resource in source/fhir.ini. The current XML source no longer has ExplanationOfBenefit.diagnosis.drg or ExplanationOfBenefit.diagnosis.packageCode; it defines root ExplanationOfBenefit.diagnosisRelatedGroup instead. Later Published issue FHIR-29688 explicitly requested adding diagnosisRelatedGroup at the Claim, ClaimResponse, and EOB roots and removing resource.diagnosis.packageCode, and commit acb64eec3c applied that later model. source/fhir.ini also lists ExplanationOfBenefit.diagnosis.packageCode as removed in the R4-to-R6 change map.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because FHIR-11392's obsolete drg name is absent, and reintroducing diagnosis.packageCode would conflict with the later final FHIR-29688 decision.
